Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle, followed by Martin Guptill and Henry Nicholls. Mustafizur Rahman will start with the ball.

Right then, Bangladesh will be disappointed with their batting effort. It started with a six from the bat of Tamim Iqbal but soon fizzled out. Everyone knew batting will be tough but the application from them was also not there. Their innings never got going as they struggled to even rotate the strike. The visitors are now left with a paltry total to defend. Can their pace attack do some miracle? We will find out soon as the run chase begins. Do join us in a short while.

Trent Boult starts by saying that it was a good toss to win and shares that he was excited to bowl on a spicy wicket which played out a few tricks. He feels that they have restricted Bangladesh to a manageable total and reckons that they will chase it down. Tells that they have a clear recipe for this format which is to swing the ball around and he is glad that they stuck to the plans. Boult talks about bowling in packs and is happy that they never allowed Bangladesh off the hook.

Every bowler of New Zealand who got the ball in his hand left his mark. Trent Boult and Matt Henry were brilliant at the start, Kyle Jamieson and James Neesham maintained the same tempo in the middle overs while Mitchell Santner also troubled the batsmen with his accuracy and clever variations. Trent finished with a 4-wicket haul and here is having a quick chat...

A professional bowling show by New Zealand! The Kiwi pacers interrogated the Bangladesh batsmen on a testing surface. There was plenty of bounce and pace on the pitch and the visiting team had a hard time dealing with the moving and bouncing balls. The wickets fell at regular intervals and there was no substantial partnership for the Bangla Tigers.

OUT! CAUGHT AT MID ON! Boult has 4 and that is the end of the innings! What a bowling performance. Slower ball on middle, Taskin Ahmed looks to go work it on the leg side but does not get the timing right. It goes towards Santner at mid on off the leading edge who takes the simplest of catches. BANGLADESH BOWLED OUT FOR 131.
Well played by Mustafizur! Yorker on middle, Mustafizur gets his bat down in time and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! That is what every fast bowler likes to see! Trent Boult proves too good for the number 10 batsman. Hasan Mahmud had no answer to that one. Full ball landing on middle, the seam is pointing towards the slip cordon and hence it moves away in that direction after landing, Mahmud tries to get forward and defend but it beats the outside edge and hits the top of off stump. A sight to love!
SWING AND A MISS! Good length ball on middle, Mahmud has a big swing at it but misses.
Trent Boult (8-0-26-2) is back on.
Good length ball outside off, Mahmud drops his wrists and lets it through to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, that is left alone for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Taskin swishes and misses.
FOUR! Packs a punch to a shortish ball outside off, good connection, decent timing and excellent placement at covers. A boundary results.
A length ball on middle and leg, tucked on the leg side for a run.
Spears in a fuller length ball on middle, Mahmud brings down a straight bat in defense.
Hasan Mahmud is the number 10 batsman.

OUT! What a catch! The timing of the jump was the key, a stunning effort by Mitchell Santner. Henry begins his new spell with a short delivery around off, Mahmudullah eyes the empty space behind the mid-wicket fielder and hence he chooses to pull it across the line. He connects decently but it lacks the desired elevation to beat the jump of the in-ring fielder. Fantastically done and it's a body blow to Bangladesh. Their last recognized batsman is back in the hut.

Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. There is a bowling change too, Matt Henry is back on. 8-1-21-0 are his figures so far.
Short ball outside off, Taskin sways away from it.
Full on the pads, Taskin flicks it to deep mid-wicket for another couple of runs. A strong throw at the bowler's end would have Mahmudullah in a spot of bother.
Back of a length ball outside off, Taskin rides the bounce and then punches it through the point region and picks up a couple.
PLAY AND A MISS! Short ball outside off, Taskin looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Short on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
LEG BYE! Back of a length ball on the pads, Taskin looks to flick but it goes off his pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.
James Neesham is back on. 7-1-22-2 are his figures so far.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease. 9 from the over, can Bangladesh capitalize from here and stretch their total close to 200?
SIX! Enough of the passiveness, Mahmudullah decides to use his feet and goes downtown. Finds the length to be apt and line to be in his arc as he thumps it over long on.
Shortish and on off, defended back from the crease.
Physio is out! The helmet is being checked and also the mandatory concussion test will be performed. All seems to be in order now.

Snorter by Kyle Jamieson! He digs it in on middle, jumping onto the batsman, Taskin takes his eyes off the ball as he attempts to fend it off. It takes his gloves, thuds on his helmet and deflects towards point. Mahmudullah calls him through for a quick run.
Another sharp delivery, rising onto the batsman from a shortish length, Taskin is on his toes as he defends it down on the surface.
Wide called for height! Sharp bouncer, well-directed, the batsman moves away but it goes well over his head.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah runs it down to third man for a single.
Flatter ball on off, spinning into the batsman. Ahmed looks to flick but gets hit high on the thigh pad.
BEAUTY FROM SANTNER! Loopy ball outside off, a carrom ball, Taskin looks to defend but gets beaten as it spins away to beat the outside edge.
Flatter on middle, Taskin goes back in his crease and then flicks it to square leg.
Flatter ball on off, Taskin defends it out.
On off, pushed to covers.
WIDE! Flatter ball outside off, Taskin looks to cut off the back foot but misses. Wided.
Flatter on middle, Mahmudullah punches it down to long on for a single.
A length ball on off, Taskin stays rooted inside the crease, lifts his front leg and defends it towards square leg.
Wrong line, on a good length and drifting down the leg side, Mahmdullah nudges it down to fine leg for one.
Beaten! Back of a length delivery outside off, holding its line, Mahmudullah tries to punch it off his back foot but misses.
A bouncer on middle and leg, Mahmudullah ducks underneath it.
Keeps it full this time, around off, Mahmudullah defends it from the crease again.
Good length ball on off, Mahmudullah defends it from the back foot.
Mahmudullah backs out. Kyle Jamieson was in his delivery stride and has to pull back. Gives a stare as he returns. You don't want to angry a fast bowler of Jamieson's height and stature.
Slower through the air on off, Taskin defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Mahmudullah pushes it towards mid on where the fielder does well to stop the single.
Flighted on off, Taskin goes for a big heave across the line but times it so poorly that it doesn't carry even to long on. A single.
Floated on off, Taskin defends it to covers.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and on off, at 136.1 kph, Mahmudullah defends it back to the bowler who picks up the ball and mimes a throw at the striker.
Bouncer on middle, Mahmudullah ducks underneath it.
Fuller in length on middle, Mahmudullah uses the angle and flicks it to mid-wicket, not in the gap though.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, Mahmudullah pushes it down towards mid on and shouts 'wait on'.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah jumps and punches it through the line, finds point.
Too full in length around off, Mahmudullah shuffles across and whips it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Kyle Jamieson returns to the attack. 5-1-13-0 are his figures so far.
On off, blocked to cover.
Tossed up on off, Ahmed defends it to covers off the front foot.
Loopy ball on middle, Taskin pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker on middle, Mahmudullah plays it down to long on for a single.
On off, punched to cover off the back foot.
Flatter ball outside off, Mahmudullah plays it to point.
Fractionally short and close to off, Taskin goes on his toes as he defends it down to the off side. Testing over by Boult.
Wide! Slips another delivery down the leg side, trying a little too hard to find that shape, Taskin allows it through.
A length ball on off, Ahmed covers the line and plays it out to covers.

Shout for a caught behind! Boult slips a full ball down the leg side, Taskin tries to flick but misses. There is definitely some noise, the Black Caps appeal but the umpire gives it a WIDE. Maybe, the bat hit the ground there to create that sound.
Good length ball on off, pushed with an angled bat to point.

'CATCH IT'... Falls safe! Boult's follow-up delivery is short and around off, Taskin is taken by surprise, tries to fend it off but it takes the shoulder of the bat. It pops out but falls safely at covers.
Spears in a very full ball on off, Taskin does really well to keep it out safely.
100 up for Bangladesh in the 33rd over! Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahmudullah stands back and runs it down to third man for a run.
Floated ball outside off, Taskin drives it to point. End of another successful over from Santner.
On off, Taskin lunges forward and then defends it to covers.
Floated on off, Taskin defends it to covers.
Floated on the pads, Mahmudullah nudges it to the leg side for a single.

Drinks break. New Zealand continue to maintain a firm grip on this match. They have snatched seven wickets of Bangladesh with the scorecard still not reading 100. It's been great bowling from the Kiwis right from the start and they would be now aiming to bundle out the innings quickly. Mahmudullah is the last recognized batsman left but he will need someone to hang around with him to take the touring team to a respectable total. Let's see whether Bangladesh manage to enter Powerplay 3 or not. Taskin Ahmed is the new batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is a brilliant catch from Henry Nicholls and Santner wins the battle between him and Mahedi Hasan! Mahedi had come out to attack the spinner but perishes and Bangladesh lose their 7th. Santner bowls it short, after seeing that Mahedi Hasan jumped out of the crease. Mahedi looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes over mid on. Nicholls backtracks and completes a good catch with a tumble. Bangladesh's innings continue to nosedive.
Flatter ball on the pads, Mahmudullah works it to square leg and scampers through for the single.
Boult switches to 'round the wicket for the last ball and darts in a shortish ball on off, Mahedi stays back and plays it down to point.
A length delivery outside off, angling across the right-hander, Hasan shoulders arms.

FOUR! Not in any control of the shot! Boult digs in another short delivery, around leg and Mahedi decides to have a go with his pull shot. He fails to middle it but still gets the desired result as it takes the gloves and flies behind the keeper.
A bouncer to keep the batsman glued inside the crease, Hasan leans back and allows it through to Latham.
Mahedi is squared up again. On a length around middle and off, it's kept out off the outer edge to point.
Beautiful delivery, on a length around middle and off, shaping away, Hasan stands back with an open stance, trying to defend but it whistles past the outside edge.
Flatter ball outside off, Hasan cuts it to point and takes a quick run to end the over.
On middle, worked to square leg.
Quicker on the pads, Mahedi gives himself some room and then nudges it to square leg.
Flatter and on the pads, Mahmudullah works it to the leg side and crosses over for a run.
Full and outside off, Mahedi drives it to deep cover for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, Mahedi defends it out.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot but straight to the cover fielder inside the ring.
FOUR! Mahmudullah gets the chance to free his arms. Back of a length ball on middle, Mahmudullah rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a rare boundary in Bangladesh's innings.
Edgy! Angling across the batsman, Hasan pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man for one.
Shortish and on off, Mahedi stands back inside the crease in defense.
Boult goes fuller this time, puts it outside off, Hasan takes his bat away at the last moment. The temptation was there!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mahedi allows it through to the keeper.
Trent Boult returns. 2/14 in his 5 overs so far. New Zealand attacking with a slip and gully.
Full and outside off, Mahedi drives it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Mahedi works it to mid-wicket.
The ball seems to have gotten lost and there is a slight halt in play. The groundstaff has finally found it and brings it back.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark in ODIs. That has gone a long way! Tossed up on off, Mahedi dances down the track and then powers it over long off for a maximum.
Floated on middle, Mahedi defends it back to the bowler.
Mahedi Hasan walks out to bat on his ODI debut.

OUT! TIMBER! An 86 kph arm ball, flatter and around middle and leg, skidding off the surface, Mehidy gets too far across the stumps as he tries to flick. Misses and it tickles the leg stump. Hasan cannot believe it, he is completely shocked, he is like he has seen a ghost. The Kiwis are celebrating and Bangladesh are staring down the barrel, 6 down with not even 100 on the scoreboard.
Full on the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
Mitchell Santner is back into the attack.
Angles in a length ball on middle, it's flicked in front of square leg but not in the gap. Scoring runs has been extremely tough!
Shortish and on middle, jumping onto the batsman who does well to work it towards square leg. The fielder there though dives to stop it.
Too full in length and on middle, Hasan manages to find the gap with his flick shot and gets off the mark with a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, angling down, Mehidy tries to work it around but it takes his thigh pad and goes to square leg.
Width on offer outside off, Mahmudullah leans back and steers it wide of gully to third man for a run.
Skiddy delivery, short and around off, Mahmudullah hops and taps it down on the leg side.
Full on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Another short ball which is bowled around middle, Mahmudullah sits under it.
Fullish ball on middle, Mahmudullah defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball around middle, Mahmudullah ducks under it.
Very full outside off, Mahmudullah digs it out to point.

OVERTHROWS! Fullish ball on off, Mahmudullah plays it to mid off and takes off for a run. The fielder runs ahead and collects. He has a shy at the bowler's end and hits but Mahmudllah is in. Another run conceded as the ball deflects to deep mid-wicket.
MAIDEN! Fullish and on middle, Mehidy clips it off his pads but finds mid-wicket.
Around off on a length, it's defended from the crease.
Pitches it up and around off, Mehidy pushes it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Length delivery on middle, Hasan covers the line and blocks it towards the right side of the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller in length on middle, Mehidy flicks but towards square leg where the fielder stops the ball with a dive.
Tom Latham is going for the kill here. Matt Henry is back on. 0/19 off his 6 overs so far.
Full on off, Mahmudullah pushes it back to the bowler. Terrific over by Neesh!
Full outside off, pushed to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Mahmudllah flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Short ball around middle, Mahmudullah ducks under it. Wided for it being too high.
On a length on middle, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket.
Mehidy Hasan is in now.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the most unfortunate way to get out! New Zealand will take it but Mithun will feel really hard done by. It was a lovely shot from Mahmudullah but Neesham did really well to get a hand to it. A full ball on middle, Mahmudullah drives it straight back. Neesham gets down and it clips the ring finger of his right hand before going on to disturb the stumps at the other end. Mithun is outside the crease at that point. The bowler is more concerned about his finger than appealing but it's too obvious and an embarrassed Mithun takes a sad walk to the pavilion. Unlucky? Slightly. One can ask, why was he backing up so much... Five down for Bangladesh!
Back of a length ball outside off, Mahmudullah punches it to point.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to the cover fielder. Keeps it tidy, Santner.
Full and flighted on off, Mahmudullah presses forward and drives it down to long off for a single. Opens his account.
Short and wide outside off, Mahmudullah cuts but finds the backward point fielder.
Wide! Fires one flat and down the leg side, Mahmudullah goes back to pull but misses. A good take behind the stumps by the Kiwi skipper.
Allows the ball to spin away and pushes at it inside the line. It goes towards first slip where Mitchell dives and parries it to point.
Some turn there! Tossed up ball around middle, turning away a shade, Mahmudullah tries to flick but it takes the leading edge and rolls to the off side.
Santner sees the batsman moving down the leg side and follows him with a flatter full ball, Mithun nudges it to backward square leg for a run.
On off, Mhamudullah goes on the back foot and then plays it to point. Another good over from Neesham comes to an end.
Bouncer bowled around middle, Mahmudullah once again ducks under it.
Shortish on middle, Mahmudullah nudges it to mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Mahmudullah lets it go to the keeper. No run.
Short ball around middle, Mahmudullah ducks under it.
Mahmudullah is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Neesham has a happy knack of picking wickets. Extra bounce brings Rahim's downfall. It's a touch short but too close to off, Rahim attempts to cut but forgets that he has to play it down with gully present. Fails to do so and it flies to Guptill who jumps and catches it with ease. The shot, to be honest, was never on. Too close to fancy that on a wicket with plenty of extra bounce. A disappointed Rahim departs. The 27-run stand off 49 balls is over.
Flatter and shorter on off, an arm ball, Mithun goes back and plays it down to point. Good tidy start from Santner.
Fires in a full ball on middle, Mithun flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Santner goes quick and flat, it's on middle and leg, Rahim helps it in front of square leg for a run.
Fuller in length and on the pads, it's nudged behind square leg for one.
Too full and on off, dipping in, this time Rahim drives it slightly wide of the diving cover fielder and picks up a single.
Floated and full around off, Rahim drives but finds the cover fielder.
Four bowlers used to bowl 20 overs so far. Now, it's the turn of Mitchell Santner to have a go. Bangladesh would feel a lot at home against him. But the key will be to not relax.
Full ball way outside off, Mithun leaves it alone.
WIDE! Too high! Short ball around off, Mithun ducks under it. Wided.
Back of a length ball on off, Mithun blocks it to point.
Shortish on middle, Mithun pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short ball on middle, Mushfiqur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish ball on off, Rahim defends it to covers and says no for the single.
FOUR! Rahim gets some width this time and he punishes it! Short outside off, Rahim cuts it over the point fielder for a boundary. A much-needed one for Bangladesh.
Maiden, first of the day! Short in length and outside off, Mithun leans back and allows it through to the keeper.
Beauty for Jamieson! That's five dot balls in a row. On a good length and just outside off, holding its line, Mithun feels for it and gets beaten.
On a length and around off, Mithun pushes it towards point. So many dot balls, they need to find a way to rotate the strike, at least.
Targets the off stump and angles in a length ball, Mithun once again has no room to work with and is forced to defend from the crease.
Extra bounce. Back of a length ball around off, Mithun gets no width to work with and defends it down. It drops adjacent to the stumps and rolls behind.
Good length ball on middle, Mithun helps it down in front of square leg. A loud shout of no follows.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahim gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it to cover.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim lets it go to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on off, tapped to gully.

FOUR! What a graceful stroke that is! This might just get Rahim going! Full ball outside off, Rahim creams the drive through cover-point for a boundary. Used the depth of the crease well. Maybe was expecting a bouncer, that's why stayed inside the crease. Great shot!

Good length ball down the leg side, Rahim looks to flick but misses. Latham dives to his left and makes a good stop. Wided! Ohh wait, the third umpire has signalled it as a No Ball and a Free Hit will follow now.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim tries to run it down to third man but the gully fielder does well to stop it.
Full on middle, Rahim flicks it to mid on for a dot.

Drinks! New Zealand have done a really good job here so far. They have taken three wickets already and are on top! Trent Boult was breathing fire at the start and he was well supported by Matt Henry. Jamieson has looked menacing while Neesham has done a decent job until now. Bangladesh, on the other hand, need a partnership to get back in the game. Rahim has struggled at the crease but the important thing for Bangladesh is that he is still at the crease and fighting it out. The visitors would need him to continue and post a big one.
Fuller in length and on middle, Mithun brings down a straight bat and defends it back.
Good length delivery outside off, extra bounce again, Mithun shoulders arms.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahim opens the face of the bat and uses the pace of the bowler to run it down to third man for a run.
Streaky! Jamieson is really unlucky so far. Fullish and around off, Mithun looks to push it through the line but it takes the inner half and rolls behind square leg for a run.
On a length and outside off, Rahim gets forward to push inside the line and edges it down to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball on middle, Rahim stays back and defends it towards the bowler.
Fullish on the pads, Mithun flicks it to square leg.
On a length on off, defended to point.
FOUR! Mithun is off the mark in fine fashion! Fifty up for Bangladesh! Full ball outside off, Mithun leans forward and chips it over the leaping cover fielder for a boundary.
Full on middle, Mithun defends it to mid on off the front foot.
Full on middle, Mithun flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, Mithun rides the bounce and then blocks it to cover-point.
Fullish and on middle, Rahim tries to flick but once again his head is in no position. Falling across a little too much and he ends up pushing it back to the bowler. Top over by Kyle!
Jamieson persisting with his line around off and trying to cramp Rahim. Good length and Rahim defends it from the back foot to point.
Full again, on off, Rahim strides forward and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Pitches it up and around off, moving in, Rahim presents the full face and pushes it gently through mid off for a couple of runs.

Beauty to beat the bat! Jamieson angles in a good length ball close to off and gets it to straighten off the seam, Rahim pushes at it and misses. That wasn't too far away from the outside edge. Kyle has his hands on his head.
Fuller length ball on middle, Rahim flicks it through mid-wicket and Conway along with Boult (from mid on) give it a chase. A couple of runs taken.
On a length on off, Mithun defends it off the back foot to point.
Full and outside off, Mohammad lunges forward and then shoulders arms to it.
Fullish ball outside off, Mithun lets it go to the keeper.
Almost! Good length ball on middle, Mithun looks to flick but gets a leading edge which goes to the off side. No harm done this time around.
Mohammad Mithun comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT AT MID ON! Das knew as soon as he hit that and he walks off. Neesham strikes immediately in his first over. Das who was playing so well has to depart. Bangladesh tottering at the moment. Neesham comes up with a cross-seam delivery, banging it in and getting it to sit up to the batsman. Das stands back to work it around but the bounce gets big on him and he fails to close the face of the bat properly. It pops out towards mid on where Boult takes a simple catch. Bangladesh desperately need a big partnership now.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim punches it past the gully fielder for a single down to third man.
James Neesham is into the attack. One slip and a gully in place.

Action replay of the previous delivery, once again Das cannot do much with it as he defends it down on the surface. Quiet going for Bangladesh, probably they are trying to preserve wickets at this stage.
Darts in a good length ball on off, Liton does well to get on top of the bounce as he defends it back.
Jamieson does it again. Fractionally short in length and outside off, Das looks to push inside the line but then drops his wrists.
Shortish and on middle, Das defends it from the back foot to the leg side.
Beauty! Extra bounce. Back of a length ball around off, Das sticks back to play but it holds its line and whizzes past the edge.
Fullish and on middle, Rahim helps it to mid-wicket with gentle hands and scoots to the other end.
Full on middle, Das works it to mid on for another dot. Just 2 from the over.
BEATEN! This is terrific bowling from Henry! Good length ball outside off, Das looks to defend without any feet movement. He gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good length ball outside off, Liton makes a leave to this one.
Full on middle, Das flicks but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Das.
Bit of aggression shown here! Short ball on middle, Das goes on his back foot and then pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region. Picks up two before the fielder cuts it off.

Good length ball on off, Rahim stays back to defend and keeps it out off the splice, probably gloves. It drops nears the popping crease and evades the stumps. Excellent first over by Kyle, barring the first delivery.

Rahim is struggling big time. He has left his front foot in Bangladesh, it seems. Jamieson angles in a length ball close to off, Rahim with confused footwork tries to play the line and gets beaten as the ball straightens off the seam.
Beaten! Footwork from Rahim is absent there. Jamieson plants his delivery on a length outside off and gets it to nip away. Mushfiqur has a tame poke inside the line and misses.
Full and on middle, Das uses the angle of the bowler and works it to mid-wicket where Boult makes a good diving stop. Cannot prevent the single though.
Terrific comeback. Too full and outside off, skidding off the surface, Das tries to dig it out but fails. Beaten for extra pace.
FOUR! Aerial but safe! Das takes the risk but gets hold of it. A bit of a loosener, full and wide outside off, Liton latches onto it and smashes it through cover-point.

Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. There is a bowling change as well. Kyle Jamieson is inserted into the attack. Expect plenty of extra bounce for him.
Good length ball on middle, Rahim defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mushfiqur drops his wrists and then lets it to go to Latham behind the stumps.
Fullish ball outside off, Rahim pushes it to covers.
On a length on middle, Das attempts to work it to the leg side but it goes off the inner half towards the square leg region for a single.
Full ball on off, Rahim pushes it to the off side and collects a run.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Good length ball around off, Rahim looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes towards second slip where it falls short.

Not an inswinger but he hurried the batsman with extra bounce. Back of a length ball on middle, shaping away, Rahim stays back to push at it but it takes the outer edge and runs down to third man. Not totally controlled but still a single.
Once again Boult takes a length delivery away with the angle, Rahim lets it go. Is he setting him up for a big inswinger?
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Rahim plants his front leg forward to cover the line and movement as he shoulders arms.
Rahim, the little man, is having a torrid time. Another shooter from Boult, on and around off, Rahim drops his wrists this time as he makes an unconvincing leave.
Beaten comprehensively! Boult digs in a shortish ball around off, Rahim is sucked into pushing inside the line and he gets beaten all ends up.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Rahim covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball on middle, Das flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Fullish ball on middle, Rahim looks to push at it but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for a single.
Too high! On a length on middle, Rahim looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. A mild appeal is put for LBW but the umpire is not keen.

An appeal for caught behind but it is turned down! What a piece of bowling from Henry though. Good length ball around off, it nips in sharply. Rahim looks to defend but gets cut in half as it goes to the keeper. Latham collects and puts in a big appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it has gone off the thigh pad.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim shoulders arms to this one.
Full and on middle, Rahim pushes it back to Henry who jumps and collects it.
Slightly short and close to off, Liton stays tall inside the crease as he taps it down to backward point.
Full and around off, Liton is patient as he brings down a straight bat in defense.
Fuller in length and on the pads, Liton flicks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket. Playing nicely under his eyes, Das.
A touch too straight on this occasion from Boult, Liton defends it from the back foot to the leg side.
Good length ball on top of off, Das sticks back to ride the bounce and defends it down safely.
Angling away from the batsman, Das pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a couple of runs. He is looking a lot composed as compared to his other teammates.
On off, defended to cover off the front foot.

Nicely timed and nicely fielded! Full ball outside off, Das lunges forward and then drives it past the diving cover fielder. The fielder chases after it and puts in a slide to pull it back in. Three taken.
Fullish ball on middle, Das lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle, Rahim tucks it to square leg and crosses over for a run.
On a length outside off, Rahim punches it to covers.

EDGED AND DROPPED! Latham tried to do too much himself and it is dropped! It was going straight to the first slip fielder but Latham blinded the first slip fielder. Good length ball on off, it moves away. Liton Das looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes towards first slip. Latham dives to his right which probably blinds Mitchell at first slip. Mitchell puts it down and it goes behind for a single.
On a length around off, that is defended solidly off the front foot. Fine over by Boult.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Rahim tries to flick but misses. A good diving take by Latham.

Test the knuckles. This one spits off the surface. A touch short and rises abnormally to Rahim who tries to defend but it hits him on the gloves and dies down near the surface. Welcome to New Zealand.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new batsman. Bangladesh need his experience to bail them out here. A leg gully of sorts in place.

OUT! Abysmal execution from Soumya Sarkar and he is dismissed for a 3-ball duck. Boult is a clever bowler. He doesn't want the batsman to get used to one length so mixes it. Trent goes short but keeps it close to the off stump line, not enough space to play the square cut or the upper cut. Sarkar although senses an opportunity to open his account by whacking it over backward point. However, the bounce gets big on him and he is cramped for room as well. Ends up chipping it in the air towards cover-point where Conway takes his first ODI catch. To be honest, even though Sarkar would have connected, third man would have been in business.
A length ball around off, it is defended solidly off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Sarkar stays back and defends it to the leg side.
Soumya Sarkar is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! One down! Tamim is trapped in front of the stumps! Boult troubled Tamim twice with the first ball of his every over and this time he has managed to remove him with his first ball of a fresh over. Not a lot of movement on this delivery, it's more about the angle of the bowler taking it into the batsman. It's full and around off, skidding in, Tamim falls over a bit too much as he tries to lean across to play the flick shot. Misses the delivery completely and gets rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. No need to even think about the DRS. Iqbal is off straightaway.
EDGY! Fullish ball on off, Iqbal looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and it goes through the gully region for a single.
Good length ball on off, Tamim strides forward and then defends it to mid off.
Shortish on middle, Tamim hops and then flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short ball on middle, Das pulls it to deep backward square leg and collects a run.
Good shot for nothing! Full ball outside off, Das drives but finds the fielder at cover.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Iqbal looks to flick but it brushes his pads and it goes to the leg side for a leg bye.
Solid in defense! A length ball on off, not moving back in enough, Das gets forward and defends it from the middle of his willow. That would make him feel good.

Superb delivery. On a good length close to off, Das hangs his bat down in defense but it skids off the surface, beats the outside edge and shoots up towards Latham who collects it over his head. Spicy deck!
Wide called for height! Boult tries to mix things up and digs in a short ball on middle, it shoots off though and goes over the head of Das.
Full in length and outside off, Das pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point where the fielder makes a diving stop.
Good piece of timing. Liton doesn't try to hit it hard, just places his drive in the gap at covers to open his account with a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball outside off, Tamim opens the face of his bat and steers it wide of backward point for a single.

Goodness me! A peach of a delivery to start the over yet again by Boult. A little bit of swing and seam this time. Angling in around off, Tamim is opened up completely in defense as the ball shapes away to beat the outside edge. Unplayable again. The replays show that it brushed the back thigh pad of Tamim before going to his counterpart behind.
Another watchful leave! Good length ball outside off, it nips in a little but not enough to make Das play as he lets it go to the keeper. 5 runs from Henry's first.
Good length ball outside off, Das watches it carefully and then shoulders arms to it.

Quick single! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Tamim flicks it to square leg and takes off for a quick single. The fielder comes ahead, collects and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Das would have been in though.
On a length on middle, Tamim stands tall and then defends it back to the bowler. Good solid batting.

FOUR! That's superbly timed by Tamim Iqbal! Henry strays somewhat here! Good length ball on the pads, Tamim flicks it through square leg and picks up a boundary. Terrific wicket to bat on, this shot proves that. You just need to see off this early phase.
Henry starts with a good length ball on off, Tamim strides forward and defends it to mid on.
Who will bowl from the other end? Matt Henry it is with the second new ball.
Boult pitches it up and around off, Das is forward and defends it watchfully to see off the first over. Eventful start from Trent!
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, angling across the batsman, Das makes a sensible leave. He is standing outside the crease to negate the movement.
Inswinger there but it starts from middle and nips down, Tamim fails to work it around and it goes behind square leg off his pads. They steal a leg bye.

SIX! Whoa! That's the way to start your tour! Unplayable ball first up and now this has been dispatched into the grass banks. Short and wide outside off, not the length to bowl when it's nipping around, Tamim stands tall and slaps it all the way over backward point. The dimension of the ground is not too big and the Bangladesh skipper has cleared the fence with ease.
Full and on off, shaping back in off the seam, Tamim strides forward and defends it back solidly.

Wow, what a delivery to start! Immediately swing in the air and movement off the pitch. Unplayable. Very full and close to the off stump line, Tamim tries his best to defend but it's too good to even take the outside edge. Fantastic beginning for Boult.

Right! We are done with the National Anthems and we are all set to begin the first ODI! The New Zealand players are in a huddle before they make their way out to the middle and they are followed by Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das. At the time of the toss, it was bright and sunny but suddenly, it has become cloudy and that will help the New Zealand seamers more. Trent Boult will start with the ball.
Both teams are out in the middle for the National Anthems. First up is Bangladesh's followed by New Zealand's.

Pitch report - A touch on the colder side, especially for the tourists who are not used to these conditions. It's a great looking pitch and there are plenty of runs in it. There will be good bounce and pace on offer for the fast bowlers and spinners will also play a part some time later.

Here is Devon Conway giving a quick interview. Says that he had a taste of international cricket and mentions that it's good to have familiar places around. Shares that there are nerves but not as bad as it was earlier. Speaks about batting at number 3 which he is accustomed to and he wants to keep it simple.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Devon Conway (ODI DEBUT), Will Young (ODI DEBUT), Tom Latham (WK/C), James Neesham, Daryl Mitchell (ODI DEBUT), Mitchell Santner, Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Trent Boult.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Mahedi Hasan (ODI DEBUT), Taskin Ahmed, Hasan Mahmud, Mustafizur Rahman.

Tamim Iqbal, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they have to be ready for the challenge. Mentions that they would have bowled first as well but he feels that the wickets normally in New Zealand are good for batting. Stresses that fast bowling is going to be the key on this tour and they have a few youngsters and he is banking on them to come good. States that they know about their poor record in New Zealand and tells that there is always an opportunity to change it.

Tom Latham, the skipper for New Zealand, says that they will bowl as it looks like a good surface and there is a little bit of green grass. On whether they look up or down while deciding what to do, Latham replies that it's a mix of everything and adds that they have the bowlers who can get movement off the pitch and in the air. Informs about the three debutants and they are excited for them. On him getting his 100th cap from his father, Tom says he was surprised and it's a very proud moment for him and hopes there are a few more to come.
Toss time - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of New Zealand. They have elected to field first.

It was expected to be slightly overcast in Dunedin at the start but the sun is out in its full glory and the University Oval is bathed in bright sunshine. A little while back the Kiwi team was in a huddle and they have three debutants who have been handed over their ODI caps. A special moment for Will Young, Devon Conway and Daryl Mitchell. We wish them all the best for their first outing in the 50-over format. A special cap for Tom Latham as well, who is playing his 100th ODI and his dad, Rod Latham, is there to hand him that. Proud moment.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between New Zealand and Bangladesh. New Zealand have had a long home season where they faced off against West Indies, Pakistan and then Australia and are now finishing off with Bangladesh who are here to play 3 ODIs and 3 T20Is. The hosts are the favourites but Bangladesh are known to punch above their weight and they can pose some problems for the hosts. The Kiwis, on the other hand, have had a successful season but they are without Taylor and Williamson in this match and they will be playing with a fairly inexperienced unit. This is their first ODI in over a year and they will look to start off the series with a win. Who will come out on top? We will find out in a while.
